steps.caption: Open Outreach: who to contact today, and why.
Tabs: Today, Messages (drafts), Conversations, Relationships, Paused and Results.
New conversations to start: people worth contacting, with a quick 'Prepare drafts'.
Choose Email, WhatsApp or Call for each suggestion.
Follow-ups due: people waiting for your reply or a promised follow-up.
Re-check follow-ups looks again for anything newly due.
To start from scratch, press New outreach.
Choose the person — Ananya Rao at Zentrix Analytics.
'What we know' lists the facts the draft is allowed to use — nothing else.
The draft appears. 'Why now' shows the reason behind it.
Edit the text freely — it is yours.
Happy with it? Approve this exact text.
Before sending, confirm the recipient and the text.
'Check & open' opens your own mail app with this text. You press Send there.
After sending, press 'I sent it' so the follow-up is tracked.
The draft is listed under Outreach → Messages until it is sent.
After 'I sent it', it moves to Conversations and the follow-up shows on Today.
